description: Ignore an error group, open it again, or mark it resolved. RESOLVED is refused while a request is linked: the request's status decides then. Pass release with RESOLVED to name the build the fix shipped in; featury then counts an error on a newer build as came back. A release featury hasn't matched to a commit is refused. ENGINEER and above.

groupId.description: Error group id (uuid): list_error_groups returns these

release.description: With RESOLVED only: the release the fix shipped in

name: set_error_group_status
title: Set error group status
